title: Frontiers: Pirating Foes or Creative Friends? Effects of User-Generated Condensed Clips on Demand for Streaming Services
eligible_reason: Single common event (boycott of user-generated condensed clips on TikTok, cutday 2021-04-09). Treatment group is time-invariant (VIP series vs. non-VIP), and after = date >= 2021-04-09 for all series. All plm two-way within models also include past (log days since release, a time-varying trend control). No staggered adoption.
design_notes: ReplicationFile.txt (R, CR line endings): DIDRe_past -> plm(ViewVolume ~ treat*after + past, index=c(ID,date), effect='twoways', model='within') (Table 2 col 1), pglm Poisson (Table 2 col 2), moderator triple interactions (Table 3, Figure 2), episode-level VIP*after*e_score_mc (Table G4), PSM/CEM matched samples (Tables E1-E2), 2022 falsification year (Table D1), price-change event (robustness). Daily series panel 2021-03-01 to 2021-06-30, 917 series.
n_eligible_specs_note: Common date, plus a time-varying past control in every column.

specs.notes: Excluded: single common event date; time-varying trend control.

data_access: proprietary platform data, shipped with masked IDs
data_files: 3_Replication_Package/data/*.parquet (tvs, tvs_full, tiktokindex, tiktokindex_2022, view_volume, view_volume_all, view_volume_2022, view_volume_price_change_event, view_volume_vip_masked, view_volume_episode, baiduindex, douban_long_reviews)
data_files_note: Real data with masked identifiers. view_volume_vip_masked.parquet is simulated (NDA) and used only for a VIP-subscriber robustness check.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Code line numbers refer to the file after converting CR line endings to LF.
